question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Inscription on a person's grave
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Epitaph"** refers to **an inscription on a tombstone in memory of the person buried there.** (समाधिलेख)

 
 
• **Example: **The epitaph on his grave reads, "Beloved father and husband, forever in our hearts."
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for an inscription on a person's grave is **"Epitaph"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Epitaph**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Monograph** (एकविषयक पुस्तक): A detailed written study of a single specialized subject or an aspect of it.

 
 
• **Example:** She wrote a monograph on the effects of climate change on polar bears.
 
 
 
• **Epistle** (पत्र): A letter, especially a formal or didactic one.
 
 
• **Example: **The Apostle Paul wrote many epistles to early Christian communities.
 
 
 
• **Prologue** (प्रस्तावना): A separate introductory section of a literary or musical work.
 
 
• **Example:** The prologue of the book sets the scene for the main story.
